segments.speaker: me
segments.text: This is just to roll out the new order form template to sales ops.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Legal signed off on the template last week, so the language is final. We're only changing the layout and the fields.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: The product lines are now a dropdown instead of free text, and the start date auto-fills from the opportunity.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: That should cut down the errors we've been seeing.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Do the old templates stop working?

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: They'll still open, but the CRM will warn if someone generates one after the first of May.

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: Let's announce it in the sales channel and at Monday's team meeting.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: I can record a two-minute walkthrough video.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Same as before. Anything outside the template goes through the deal desk queue.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: Can the deal desk queue link be in the template footer?

segments.speaker: me
segments.text: And training for the new hires starting in May?

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: I'll add the walkthrough to their onboarding checklist.
